name: Bread Salad (Panzanella) with Tuna, Tomatoes, Mozzarella & Olives

instructions.primary_message: Cut or tear bread into bite-sized pieces. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 slices sourdough bread
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until croutons are golden and toasted, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and mince onion. Peel and mince garlic. Place both in a large bowl along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium red onion
3 cloves garlic
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
¼ cup red wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain tuna, add to the bowl with the dressing, and flake with a fork. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 (170 g) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Large dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop olives. Add to the bowl.
Chop or tear mozzarella into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (227 g) pkgs fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Add the cooled croutons and capers to the bowl. Stir once more to combine the salad.
To serve, divide panzanella salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
